column7: Defence in depth for #2692, core only: loadTOTPSecret, the one seed read behind login (VerifyMFACredentials), re-auth (requireReauth) and step-up (verifyMFAStepUpCode), refuses a not-activated secret, so the end state the race produced (MFAEnabled=true over a pending seed) cannot satisfy any verifier. Calibrated: the same code passes once the row is activated. Red with the check removed.
